name: coflux
description: Report Claude Code activity to the local coflux daemon so the coflux command center shows live per-workspace turn states.

interface.shortDescription: Report Claude Code activity to the coflux command center.
interface.longDescription: Coflux connects Claude Code to the owner's coflux agent command center. The plugin wires the relevant hook events (prompt submission, tool use, permission requests, stop, notifications) to the cofluxd messenger, which forwards only the event name, notification type, session id, in-flight background task count, and pid to the local daemon — prompts and replies never leave the machine. The daemon maps events to turn states (active / approval / question / done) shown live in the coflux web sidebar, so a human can supervise many parallel agents and see at a glance which workspace is working and which is waiting for them. A turn that ends while background work is still in flight stays active rather than reporting done, because that work will wake the agent back up. When cofluxd is not installed the hooks are silent no-ops. A companion skill documents the reporting pipeline and how to diagnose the daemon with cofluxd status, doctor, and logs.
defaultPrompt: Use coflux to check why the coflux daemon looks offline.
Use coflux to explain how workspace activity states are reported.
